author: blu
body: The full Old School 93/94 metagame test. Fed the nine foundation sets (LEA/LEB/2ED/3ED/ARN/ATQ/LEG/DRK/FEM) concatenated on stdin, it dedupes the reprints by name into one format pool, fields four archetypes, and plays a rigorous round-robin (repeats best-of-three per ordered pair) to produce the metagame matrix and a format-health verdict. Old School is played today under modern rules, so the gauntlet runs the no-mana-burn epoch (matchup-matrix's default). Run it with apps/games/magic/run-oldschool.ps1, which builds the combined stream and boots this kernel.
